enhancements.name: Guiding Presence
enhancements.description: **AELDARI PSYKER** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **visible** friendly **AELDARI VEHICLE** unit within 6" of this model. That **VEHICLE** unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.

enhancements.name: Spirit Stone of Raelyth
enhancements.description:
**AELDARI PSYKER** model only.
- While this model is within 3" of a friendly **AELDARI VEHICLE** unit, this model has **Lone Operative**.
- In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly **AELDARI VEHICLE** model within 3" of this model. That **VEHICLE** model **heals** D3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Psychic Destroyer
enhancements.description: ^^Asuryani^^ ^^Psyker^^ model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Phoenix Gem
enhancements.description: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one of more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.description: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Timeless Strategist
enhancements.description: ^^Asuryani^^ model only. At the start of the battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield (or any Transport it is embarked within is on the battlefield), you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Crucible of Malediction
enhancements.description: **^^Haemonculus^^** model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a **^^Psyker^^** unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Eye of Spite
enhancements.description: **^^Succubus^^** model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

enhancements.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
enhancements.description:
**^^Archon^^** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.
Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Vitality
enhancements.description: **^^Drukhari^^** model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities

enhancements.name: Phantasmal Smoke
enhancements.description:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within 6" of a friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^:
Models in the bearer’s unit have the  Stealth ability
Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
enhancements.description: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time you spend 1 Pain token to Empower the bearer’s unit in the Shooting phase, select one friendly ^^**Drukhari Transport**^^ within 6" of the bearer’s unit; until the end of the phase, each time that ^^**Transport**^^ makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Raider
enhancements.description: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, if that enemy unit was within range of one or more objective markers when the bearer’s unit was selected to fight, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

enhancements.name: Nightmare Shroud
enhancements.description: ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Each time the bearer’s unit disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.description: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^, that ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^ has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Webway walker
enhancements.description: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Reaper's Cowl
enhancements.description: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

enhancements.name: Conductor of Torment
enhancements.description:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In your Command phase, you can do one of the following:
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Harlequins**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.

enhancements.description: **AELDARI PSYKER** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **visible** friendly **AELDARI VEHICLE** unit within 6" of this model. That **VEHICLE** unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.

enhancements.description: **^^Asuryani Mounted^^** model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.description: Asuryani Mounted model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Seersight Strike
enhancements.description: Asuryani Mounted Psyker model only. Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer have the [Anti-Monster 2+] and [Anti-Vehicle 2+] abilities.

enhancements.name: Echoes of Ulthanesh
enhancements.description: Asuryani Mounted model only. In your Command phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is not within your deployment zone, and adding an additional 1 to the result if the bearer is within your opponent's deployment zone: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Light of Clarity
enhancements.description: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of Infanty models in that unit and add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of Monster models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Stave of Kurnous
enhancements.description: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer (excluding Titanic units). Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [Precision] ability.

enhancements.name: Rune of Mists
enhancements.description: Spiritseer model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, unless the attacking model is within 18, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Higher Duty
enhancements.description: **SPIRITSEER** model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Craftworld's Champion
enhancements.description: Asuryani model only. The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

enhancements.name: Ethereal Pathway
enhancements.description: Asuryani model only. In the Deploy Armies step, select up to two Guardians units from your army. Models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Protector of the Paths
enhancements.description: Asuryani model only. While the bearer is leading a Dire Avengers or Guardians unit, once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control.

enhancements.name: Breath of Vaul
enhancements.description: **ASURYANI** model only. While the bearer is leading a **STORM GUARDIANS** unit, each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a flamer equipped by a model in that unit, you can re‑roll the result, and each time you make a Damage roll for a model equipped with a fusion gun in that unit, you can re‑roll the result.

enhancements.name: Cegorach's Coil
enhancements.description: Troupe Master model only. Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit, then roll one D6 for each model in the bearer's unit that is within Engagment Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

enhancements.name: Mask of Secrets
enhancements.description: Harlequins model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

enhancements.name: Murder's Jest
enhancements.description: Death Jester model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets a unit that is below Half-strength, each successful Hit scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Mistweave
enhancements.description: Shadowseer model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Gaze of Ynnead
enhancements.description: Farseer model only. The bearer's Eldritch Storm weapon has the [Devastating Wounds] ability.

enhancements.name: Storm of Whispers
enhancements.description: Warlock model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Borrowed Vigour
enhancements.description: **^^Archon^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Morbid Might
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Lucid Eye
enhancements.description: Asuryani Psyker model only. In your Command phase, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the value of one Fate dice in your Fate dice pool.

enhancements.name: Runes of Warding
enhancements.description: **^^Asuryani Psyker^^** model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds caused by attacks with the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

enhancements.name: Stone of Eldritch Fury
enhancements.description: Asuryani Psyker model only. Add 12" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Torc of Morai-Heg
enhancements.description: Asuryani Psyker model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of the bearer with a Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, increase the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Aspect of Murder
enhancements.description: **^^Autarch^^** or **^^Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have the **[PRECISION]** ability.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Wisdom
enhancements.description: ^^**Autarch^^** or ^^**Autarch Wayleaper^^** model only. While the bearer is leading an ^^**Aspect Warriors^^** unit, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, until the end of the phase, models in that unit gain both of the abilities from the Path of the Warrior Detachment rule.

enhancements.name: Shimmerstone
enhancements.description: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Strategic Savant
enhancements.description: Autarch or Autarch Wayleaper model only. While the bearer is leading an Aspect Warriors unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Master Regenesist
enhancements.description: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Each time the bearer uses its Fleshcraft ability, you can return up to D3+3 destroyed Bodyguard models to the bearer's unit instead of D3+1.

enhancements.name: Master Nemesine
enhancements.description: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. The bearer's weapons have the ^^**[Anti-Beast 2+]**^^ and ^^**[Anti-Monster 4+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: Master Artisan
enhancements.description: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Master Repugnomancer [Aura]
enhancements.description: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Fear Incarnate ability, and each time a friendly ^^**Drukhari**^^ within 9" of the bearer fails a Battle-shock test or is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1 Pain token.

enhancements.name: Leechbite Plate
enhancements.description: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+. At the start of either player's Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Webway Awl
enhancements.description: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability, and you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Informant Network
enhancements.description: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three ^^**Kabalite Warriors**^^ and/or ^^**Hand of the Archon**^^ units from your army; those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.description: ^^**Archon**^^ models only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pharmacophex
enhancements.description: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. At the start of your Command phase, after selecting which Combat Drugs will be active for your army, roll one D6 and consult the Combat Drugs list. The result rolled applies to the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase in addition to any other Combat Drugs that are active for your army. If you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

enhancements.name: Chronoshard
enhancements.description: ^^** Succubus**^^ model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.description: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Morghenna's Curse
enhancements.description: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1.

enhancements.name: Key of Ghosts
enhancements.description: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only (excluding ^^**Solitaire**^^ models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Fanged Leer
enhancements.description: ^^**Death Jester**^^ model only. When using the bearer’s Cruel Amusement ability, you can select two of the abilities for its shrieker cannon to gain, instead of one.

enhancements.name: Shedskin Raiment
enhancements.description: ^^**Shadowseer**^^ model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Harlequins units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Weavers' Wail
enhancements.description: ^^**Troupe Master**^^ model only. Add 3 to the Strength and add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Pirate Prince
enhancements.description: ^^**Prince Yriel**^^ unit only. Each time you spend a Battle Focus token to enable this unit to perform an Agile Manoeuvre, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Battle Focus token.

enhancements.name: Alacritous Assault
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the ^^**[LANCE]**^^ ability.

enhancements.name: Exotic Munitions
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the ^^**[ANTI‑MONSTER 5+]**^^ and ^^**[ANTI‑VEHICLE 5+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: Adrenal Infusions
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe Infantry**^^ unit only. This unit can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without spending a Battle Focus token to do so. It can do so even if other units have done so in the same phase, and doing so does not prevent other units from performing the same Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase.

enhancements.name: Infamy (Aura)
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. While an enemy unit is within 3” of this unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit (to a minimum of 1).

enhancements.name: Webway Pathstone
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe**^^ unit only. Models in this unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can use this ability. If it does, remove this unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.description:
^^**Anhrathe Character**^^ unit only. At the start of the battle, select one ^^**Character**^^ model in this unit. That model has the following ability: 

**Lord of Deceit (Aura):** Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Voidstone
enhancements.description: ^^**Anhrathe Infantry**^^ unit only. Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: A Foot in the Future
enhancements.description: **TROUPE MASTER** model only. This unit can re‑roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Mistweave
enhancements.description: **SHADOWSEER** model only. This unit has **Infiltrators**.

enhancements.name: Camouflaged Snipers
enhancements.description: **RANGERS** unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks do not prevent this unit from being **hidden**.

enhancements.name: Assassin's Eye
enhancements.description: **RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS** unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks that target a **CHARACTER** unit have +1 **AP**.

enhancements.name: Prelude Performer
enhancements.description: **HARLEQUINS** model only. This unit has **Scouts 6"**.

enhancements.name: Shadowfall Masks
enhancements.description: **TROUPE** unit only. This unit has **Fights First**.

enhancements.name: Hyperstimm Trafficker
enhancements.description: **SUCCUBUS** model only. This unit has +1 **T**.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.description: **SUCCUBUS** model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with **snap shooting** attacks.

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.description:
**ARCHON** model only. This unit has:
- +1 **Ld** and **OC**.

enhancements.name: Contempt For Rivals
enhancements.description: **ARCHON** model only. This unit’s attacks have **[PRECISION]**.

enhancements.name: Gnarlskin Experimentor
enhancements.description: **HAEMONCULUS** model only. Attacks that target this unit with a **S** greater than your unit’s **T** have ‑1 to **wound rolls**.

enhancements.name: Elixir of the Corpse Courts
enhancements.description: **CRONOS/TALOS** unit only. This unit has **5+ InSv**.

stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.
